name: ResourceHeader
title: Templates/Headers/ResourceHeader
summary: The console bar for every page inside the persistent shell, at its first and second level of resource. A `GlobalHeader` in its default `content` placement, sitting in the content zone beside the navigation rail. Start: the navigation trigger below `md`, the brand, and from the second level the breadcrumb from `md`. End: search first, then Create, the Agent button and the account avatar. The first level has no breadcrumb (the rail's active row names the module); the second level names the module and the resource. Below `md` the sample collapses Create and Agent into icon buttons, and from a bar width of `--container-2xl` the `SearchTrigger` widens into the field with its ⌘K / Ctrl K keycap. Both thresholds are read from the theme tokens. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `Breadcrumb` (second level), `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `SearchTrigger`, `Button`, `ButtonHighlight`, `Avatar` and `Brand`.

variants.name: SecondLevel
variants.summary: A resource inside a module. The breadcrumb names the module and the resource, and shows from `md`; the last crumb is the current page and carries no link.
